`fx-rates-daily.json` is the Bank of Canada's daily exchange rates from its Valet API (the
`FX_RATES_DAILY` group, https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/observations/group/FX_RATES_DAILY/json),
fetched on 2026-11-08 (commit df9ea0b, ducat #110).

Source: Bank of Canada. Reused free of charge with attribution, under the Bank's terms
(https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/).
